title: Phase 3 roadmap and deferred deployment amendment

roadmap_amendment.reason: The planned private VPS is not yet available; domain, integration, UI and export work may continue without weakening the deployment gate.

phase_three_boundary.title: Decision Intelligence Experience
phase_three_boundary.goal: Turn portfolio evidence and compatible TRD Bot outputs into an explainable owner-reviewed daily decision workflow.

phase_three_roadmap.title: Phase 3 Roadmap and Deferred Deployment Amendment
phase_three_roadmap.outcome: Authorize bounded local continuation while preserving the blocking private-VPS gate.

phase_three_roadmap.title: Decision, Review and Journal Domain Freeze
phase_three_roadmap.outcome: Freeze decision evidence, owner review and outcome-journal invariants.

phase_three_roadmap.title: TRD Bot v0.3.1 Integration Contract
phase_three_roadmap.outcome: Freeze the capabilities, snapshots, event feed, commands, resync and service-auth boundary.

phase_three_roadmap.title: Durable Decision and Event Projection
phase_three_roadmap.outcome: Project compatible decision evidence with cursors, replay, quarantine and gap recovery.

phase_three_roadmap.title: Decision Feed and Candidate Details
phase_three_roadmap.outcome: Expose owner-scoped decision and candidate evidence with complete source references.

phase_three_roadmap.title: Risk Gate Explanation and Reason Codes
phase_three_roadmap.outcome: Explain policy version, checksum, uncertainty and every approval, rejection or deferral reason.

phase_three_roadmap.title: Portfolio Candidate Impact and Bounded What-if
phase_three_roadmap.outcome: Show advisory exposure, concentration and bounded scenario impact without execution capability.

phase_three_roadmap.title: Human Accept, Reject and Defer Workflow
phase_three_roadmap.outcome: Persist idempotent owner reviews with reasons, evidence version and optimistic concurrency.

phase_three_roadmap.title: Alert Inbox, Acknowledge and Snooze
phase_three_roadmap.outcome: Deliver durable owner-scoped alert lifecycle without mutating source evidence.

phase_three_roadmap.title: Watchlist and Monitoring Preferences
phase_three_roadmap.outcome: Persist owner watchlists and bounded presentation or monitoring preferences.

phase_three_roadmap.title: Decision and Outcome Journal
phase_three_roadmap.outcome: Link decisions, reviews, observed outcomes and owner notes without rewriting historical evidence.

phase_three_roadmap.title: Phase 3 Export Coverage
phase_three_roadmap.outcome: Extend private-complete and AI-safe exports across decisions, reviews, alerts, watchlists and outcomes.

phase_three_roadmap.title: UI Integration, Accessibility and End-to-end
phase_three_roadmap.outcome: Deliver the bilingual responsive decision workflow with explicit empty, error and degraded states.

phase_three_roadmap.title: Phase 3 Acceptance and Freeze
phase_three_roadmap.outcome: Bind migrations, projection recovery, exports, accessibility, browser and provider smoke evidence to one SHA.

transition.candidate_commit_message: docs(nexora): define Phase 3 roadmap and defer VPS gate
